messages:
alice_support: FYI customer BrightCo opened a support case — AWS Marketplace invoice shows duplicated line items for our SKU around Nov 3 DST fallback. They say our dashboard usage matches expected, invoice is ~2x for a 2-hour window. attaching invoice snippet and marketplace usage id.

ben_billing: can you paste the AWS invoice ID + MP order id? and the redwood-tenant id so I can pull marketplace reports?

alice_support: invoice: INV-8841-GB, aws-order: 9876543210, tenant: brightco-prod-01. Customer says discrepancy = ~18,200 tokens / $123.45.

charlie_eng: quick thought — Nov 3 DST fallback commonly causes duplicated local-hour intervals if metering timestamps are converted poorly. We meter in UTC but aggregation pipeline attempts a local-day rollup for reporting. any chance the rollup job double-counted the 1:00-2:00 hour? :thinking_face:

alice_support: here's the minimal CSV from their invoice (redacted):
```
line_item_id,sku,timestamp,quantity,unit_price
li-1001,redwood.embed.small,2024-11-03T01:15:00-05:00,9100,0.00001
li-1002,redwood.embed.small,2024-11-03T01:45:00-04:00,9100,0.00001
```
They highlighted that both entries appear as separate line items on AWS but our timeseries shows a single combined 18,200 tokens at 01:30 UTC.

ben_billing: hmm those offsets look like a DST offset change (-05:00 then -04:00). AWS Marketplace reports are in the buyer’s local timezone sometimes, whereas our usage logs are UTC. We need to correlate the Marketplace-metering UUIDs to our metering events to see if the same meter was billed twice.

charlie_eng: agree. I'll pull the metering logs for brightco-prod-01 for Nov 3. If our metering UUID is present twice with two timestamps that overlap, it means the marketplace listener may have re-sent the usage record during the clock shift. Also check idempotency key handling in the mp adapter.

infra-bot: logs link: https://logs.redwood.internal/brightco-prod-01/ns=marketplace/2024-11-03 (access limited)

alice_support: I asked customer to confirm timezone on their side; they responded "US/Eastern". They also attached the MP usage reporting CSV with marketplace-metering-id values: mm-abc-123, mm-abc-123 (same id appears twice).

charlie_eng: that’s the smoking gun — same marketplace-metering-id repeated. Looks like our ingestion accepted both events instead of deduping by the MP metering id. The ingestion path should drop repeat meter events (idempotency). I'll trace handler.

charlie_eng: repro steps I ran locally:
1) simulate marketplace POST with meterId=mm-abc-123, quantity=9100, timestamp=2024-11-03T06:15:00Z
2) simulate same POST with timestamp shifted by -1h but same meterId
Result: existing aggregator inserted two separate daily buckets because the rollup key included local-day (US/Eastern) + meterId was not part of dedupe key.

alice_support: can you paste the offending aggregation snippet? customer asked for root cause and whether we'll credit.

charlie_eng: snippet: ```
// rollup key currently: tenant + sku + local_day
const key = `${tenant}:${sku}:${localDay}`
// missing meterId dedupe key so duplicate meter posts in DST hour get aggregated twice
```
I'll open a PR to include the marketplace-metering-id in the dedupe key and make ingestion idempotent.

ben_billing: for immediate customer resolution, finance can issue a one-off credit for the delta if confirmed. Need an exact delta amount and approval from sales. @linda_sales can sign off?

linda_sales: saw the thread — okay to credit one-time for customer goodwill. credit amount = $123.45. Please document in the credit memo: "AWS Marketplace duplicated line item due to DST ingestion duplication — one-off credit".

alice_support: noted. I'll propose credit and create the finance ticket. Any guidance on comms? customer wants ETA for fix.

charlie_eng: ETA for hotfix: I'll prepare a small change to the aggregator to include meterId and to normalize timestamps to UTC before computing local_day. Plan: code review today, canary tomorrow during low-traffic window, full rollout in 24-36h. commit: 7f4a2c1 (draft).

ben_billing: after hotfix we'll need to run a reconciliation job to detect any other tenants affected and compute exposure. I'll queue a backfill check for Nov 2-5.

alice_support: customer update drafted: "We identified duplicated marketplace events during the Nov 3 DST fallback. We will issue a one-time credit of $123.45 today and deploy a backend fix to prevent reoccurrence; full reconciliation across your billing window is underway." want me to send now?

linda_sales: yes send. :+1:

charlie_eng: note for SRE: ensure ingestion consumer respects MP metering id as dedupe key and that downstream daily-agg is idempotent. I'll coordinate with eng-oncall if any hiccups during canary.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline created: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/marketplace-dedupe/7f4a2c1

alice_support: thanks team. tagging for records: #customer-brightco, case 49210. closing loop after finance posts credit and reconciliation results. :white_check_mark:
